verdict.rationale: Intuit publishes official SDKs on GitHub (oauth-jsclient for Node.js, QuickBooks-V3-PHP-SDK for PHP) with documented OAuth flows and CRUD examples, giving AI-native developers real code to build against; there's also an official MCP server for QBO with 145 tools/29 entities. missing for 10: evidence of a broader/first-party language SDK ecosystem (e.g. Python, Java, .NET), machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes show openapi.json/swagger.json all 404), and independent developer corroboration of SDK quality/maintenance.
